Open by the rule itself: an account erased on ANOTHER device leaves this device's entries until the period ends (a refused refresh cannot tell an erased account from a revoked session), and entries of a revoked membership or a deleted tenant end as `failed` and wait 90 days instead of being discarded at once (review GDPR-002 / GDPR-006 of #2757). Both periods are placeholder defaults of #2759 (REQ-053 §32.6 item 14); the TTDSG classification of the on-device storage is with the legal review (#2517) (#2759) |
